messages:
Nico Hart: Quick intro 2D I'm Nico, new SDR starting today. Still waiting on Outreach seat and Gong. Who can unblock me? :wave:
Rani Kapoor: welcome Nico! Pinged SalesOps. Rani Kapoor: Also: check the "oncall-seed" list for prospected accounts we share.
Maeve Torres: I'll add you to the Outreach org. Maeve Torres: Can you verify your preferred time-blocks for discovery calls?
Nico Hart: mornings 9am-12pm PT are best.
SalesOpsBot: Ticket created: SALES-6210 for Outreach + Gong. ETA 1 business day.
Maeve Torres: outreach invite sent. Should land in your email.
Nico Hart: got it. Thanks everyone.
Rani Kapoor: FYI SDR playbook link: https://redwood-internal/notion/sdr-playbook (check sections: objection handling, script A/B).
Nico Hart: saw it. Can someone point me to the 'when to escalate to AE' guideline?
Maeve Torres: it's under the objections section, bullet 4. Short rule: budget + timeline + authority missing -> escalate.
Nico Hart: perfect. Appreciate it.
